payload.cluster_definition: drawing one family carries ALL of that family's rows into the replicate: 3 realizations x 4 conditions = 12 rows

ece_semantics.statement: s_A is a normalized Evidence-Support Score, not a calibrated posterior. No NLL or ECE probability-calibration claim may be made for s_A or for F(x). The per-modality temperature scaling reported in gate_rule.json applies to p_vision / p_tof only.

implementation.superseded_entry_point: pcmef.perception.gate.paired_bootstrap_delta -- resamples base_scenario_id at seed 20260831. It was used for the deterministic-gate pilot and must NOT be used for Final E2: neither its resample unit nor its seed satisfies this lock.

metric_definitions.cluster_bootstrap_ci_95: 95% CI of the paired delta under family-cluster resampling
metric_definitions.note: worst_condition_macro_f1, declared as e2.primary_metric in configs/base.yaml, is the minimum over per_condition_macro_f1 and is therefore derivable from the reported quantities.
metric_definitions.overall_accuracy: fraction of the 384 condition rows classified correctly
metric_definitions.overall_macro_f1: unweighted mean of the four per-class F1 scores
metric_definitions.paired_effect_delta: PC-MEF minus baseline, on identical rows
metric_definitions.per_condition_accuracy: accuracy within each of the four conditions (96 rows each)
metric_definitions.per_condition_macro_f1: macro-F1 within each of the four conditions

payload.shared_clusters_across_methods: within one bootstrap replicate every compared method uses the SAME set of family clusters, so the paired delta carries no different-sample noise

training_seed_aggregation.reason: only one checkpoint pair exists (NOTE-050); there is nothing to aggregate over and no training-seed robustness is claimed
